'''Ran Fa "Farlie" Li''', also known as '''Mr. Farlie''', is a character in the [[Grand Theft Auto]] series who appears as a minor character in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. He is the [[Gang Leaders|leader]] of the [[Red Gecko Tong]] and Shuk Foo of the [[San Fierro Triads]]. He does not speak, merely grunting, but is voiced by [[Hunter Platin]], who has also voiced [[Phil Cassidy]] (in [[Grand Theft Auto III]]), [[Curly Bob]], [[Chico]], [[Rico]] and [[The Psycho]].

==Character history==
Farlie was born in China and at an unknown time joined the [[San Fierro Triads|Triads]], rising through the organisation before moving to the west coast of the [[United States of America|United States]]. He later cemented his place in the Triads and became the [[Gang Leaders|Shuk Foo]]. In [[1992]], he visits [[San Fierro]] and meets the leader of the group in [[San Andreas in GTA III Era|San Andreas]], [[Gang Leaders|Dai Dai Lo]] [[Wu Zi Mu|Wu Zi "Woozie" Mu]], leader of the [[Mountain Cloud Boys]] gang, travelling with his translator [[Su Xi Mu|Su Xi "Suzie" Mu]], who is able to translate his grunts into English.

Woozie's friend and protagonist [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]] first meets Farlie when visiting Woozie and volunteers to retrieve a package from [[Easter Bay Airport]], which he was [[Ran Fa Li (mission)|successfully completed]] after Woozie suggested that using Carl, an outsider, would draw less suspicion from the recently arrived Vietnamese gang, the [[Da Nang Boys]]. Carl later [[Lure (GTA SA)|draws Da Nang Boys gangsters]] to [[Whetstone]] from Woozie's [[Wu Zi Mu's Apartment|apartment]] in [[Chinatown, San Fierro|Chinatown]] to allow Farlie to escape. Farlie, Woozie and Carl later become business partners, [[Fish in a Barrel|taking equal shares]] in [[The Four Dragons Casino]] on [[The Strip]], [[Las Venturas]].
